result.summary: One visible visual/content issue: a restaurant name is truncated in the horizontal 'Fastest near you' list, making the label appear incomplete.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row shows the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' with the final letters cut off, so the full name is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Allow the text to wrap, widen the card/container, or add an ellipsis with a tooltip/full title so users can read the complete restaurant name.
